description: Use this when you need to check your feeds: without feed_id it lists every feed and the prepaid sats balance; with feed_id it returns that feed's status, schedule and next delivery. Read-only. Example: get_feeds(feed_id="...")

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_...), returned once by buy_credits or create_feed. Send it on every later feed or credit call.

name: get_feeds
title: List feeds or get one
